hypotheses.question: the behaviour subspace holds the direction of improvement
hypotheses.rule:
energy of g_u in b >= 3x the mean energy over the 20 random
subspaces in >= 4 of the 6 Walker2d cells

hypotheses.question: a GIBO decision beats TD3 for the same env steps
hypotheses.rule:
G-b decision gain > 0 and > td3 increment for its cost in >= 4 of
the 6 Walker2d cells

hypotheses.question: HalfCheetah control: no harm
hypotheses.rule:
median over the 6 HalfCheetah cells of G-b decision gain /
|R_actor| >= -2%
